name: menu-to-gameplay
demonstrates: PLAY enters .gameplay and shows the streamed isometric city: ground lattice, whole-building sprites, and the player actor, with no placeholder text over it. Rooftop signs aren't guaranteed in frame (~1-in-3 blocks). Gate is human/vision review of the gameplay-city screenshot; placeholder-label removal is pinned by ScreensTests, not this journey.

steps.target: the large neon-outlined PLAY button in the middle of the title screen that starts a new run (NOT the plain HIGH SCORES button below it)
